(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The method of claim 1 further comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __only__ if the filtered EPG information is less than a predefined threshold of available channels. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __based on updated authorization information;__ and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber __based on the updated authorization information__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber __in real-time__ from the content delivery provider; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __in real-time.__

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __that were created in real-time__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data further comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __if it is determined to be below a designated channel threshold__. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data causing the machine to perform filtering comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __through updated authorization information;__ and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber __as determined by the updated authorization information__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform obtaining comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber __in real-time__ from the content delivery provider; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __in real-time__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform removing comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: reading the EPG information; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __that resulted from the real-time creation__.
